name: Gong
description: Gong is a revenue intelligence platform that captures and analyzes sales calls, emails, and meetings to surface deal risk, coach reps, and ground pipeline forecasting in real customer interactions.
best_for: Sales organizations that want conversation-level visibility into deals, including call recording, deal-risk scoring, and forecasting grounded in actual customer interactions.
features: Conversation capture and analysis across calls, email, and meetings, unified into a "Revenue Graph"
Deal Intelligence for pipeline visibility, risk prediction, and automated deal handoffs
Gong Forecast for org-wide revenue forecasting grounded in captured interactions
Gong Engage for prioritizing sales engagement activity
Gong Enable for rep coaching grounded in real call data
Gong Agents that automate follow-ups, pipeline edits, and forecast corrections
Free integration with a team's existing tech stack regardless of plan
pros: Documents a broad certification set on its trust page: SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, 27017, 27018, 27701, and 42001 (an AI management system standard), plus PCI DSS SAQ D, CSA STAR Registry membership, and participation in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework
States customer conversation data is never used to train generative models, per its trust page
Integrating existing tech stack tools is free regardless of plan, per its pricing FAQ
cons: No published self-serve pricing; quotes are scaled by company-size band (1-50, 51-1,000, 1,001-9,999, or 10,000+ users) rather than a flat number
Pricing combines per-user licenses with a separate platform fee, so total cost isn't a single per-seat figure
No free trial is mentioned on the pricing page

faq.question: Does Gong publish its pricing?
faq.answer: No. Gong's pricing page states licenses are priced per user plus a platform fee based on the number of users supported, with quotes segmented by company-size band, but no dollar amounts are published.

faq.question: Is Gong SOC 2 certified?
faq.answer: Yes. Gong's trust page lists SOC 2 Type 2 among its certifications, alongside multiple ISO/IEC standards (27001, 27017, 27018, 27701, and 42001) and PCI DSS SAQ D.

faq.question: Does Gong use customer call data to train AI models?
faq.answer: Gong's trust page states: "Your data is never used to train generative models."

alternatives.name: Clari
alternatives.description: A revenue orchestration platform providing AI-driven forecasting, pipeline inspection, and deal-risk signals for enterprise revenue teams.
alternatives.best_for: Teams whose primary need is forecasting and pipeline inspection across a broader revenue-orchestration suite.
